name: Bandit raid
announce: Word comes that bandits are gathering on the roads. They will strike in {days} days. (They look to be about {strength} strong; the town's defenses stand at {defense}.)
victory: The raiders were driven off. The town holds its head high.
defeat: The raiders broke through and plundered the town.

name: Warband
announce: A warband from across the border marches on the town. It will arrive in {days} days. (It looks to be about {strength} strong; the town's defenses stand at {defense}.)
victory: The warband broke on the town's defenses and fled.
defeat: The warband sacked the town before moving on.
